description: Maximality belongs to the optional: [++T] and [+T] of one terminal in one stage. On C X B, y elides T after body → X, but body → X B is longer, so the [++T] omission is forbidden and the text is rejected at the T (engine §3.8, §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text x | y
%rule x A body [+T] B
%rule y C body [++T] B
%rule body X | X B
